title: Persona team for global orchestrator sessions
summary: Turns global orchestrator sessions into a team of personas that watch the installation from different aspects (security, operations, reliability, quality, design, product, cost, documentation), each with a versioned charter, an honest character sheet, a budget carved from the workspace token limit, a configurable reporting obligation, its own feed and management page. Two manager personas decide within standing grants; a weekly magazine and a presenter deck rank every item by a 0 to 100 importance number computed from impact, urgency and confidence with fact floors. A dedicated operations warden watches backups and the security posture and reports the magazine's fifteen-row Operations watch panel, so a missing or stale backup or an expired credential always ranks high. Personas run as short sessions of their own principal on runner hosts, scheduled by the Watcher sweep. Twelve decisions with recommended options, diagrams, mockups, light and dark evidence captures, a phased plan and twelve implementation cards. The owner decided PT-D1 to PT-D12 as recommended on 9 November 2026. A capabilities addendum of 10 November 2026 separates roles from persona instances assigned to an installation, workspace or project, and adds a versioned catalogue of interfaces and actions, per-persona grants on standing grants with explicit time-boxed T2 grants, triggers, usage records and an append-only log per persona (pending PT-D13 to PT-D20, slices PT-13 to PT-20).

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573), decisions PT-D1, PT-D12. ## Deliver
Add `docs/app/schemas/persona.schema.json` for the descriptor fields in the Dossier's Persona definition table (id, revision, title, aspect, kind persona|presenter|manager, charter of at most 600 characters, scope, attributes, operations, model capability class and thinking, cadence, triggers, budget, report, floors). Principals and grants (PT-2), scheduling (PT-3), any UI (PT-6).

- Every starter descriptor validates and the revision test fails on an unversioned change

- A fork is independent of later catalogue revisions until the Owner adopts one

# Persona scheduling, admission and budget ledger

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573), decisions PT-D3, PT-D4. Read that Dossier and its workbench.json first, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/model-selection-and-fallback/index.html and docs/concepts/workspace-quotas.md. ## Deliver
On each Watcher sweep, compute due persona occurrences from cadence and triggers (decision stream events such as batch.red, escalation.opened, quota.exhausted, quota.fallback-active, deploy completed, plus fact triggers for the warden). Add consumer class `persona` to ModelSelectionService with same-capability-class fallback, otherwise `wait`. Every refusal writes a no-call receipt with the reason. Write persona usage to the token ledger as consumer `persona:<id>`.

## Out of scope
The occurrence itself and scoring (PT-4); budget UI (PT-6).

- A restart or a duplicate trigger yields one occurrence per key
- At 80 % workspace use, persona occurrences are refused with a receipt while card admission is unchanged

- Ledger totals reconcile with occurrence receipts for a replayed week

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573), decisions PT-D9. Read that Dossier and its workbench.json first, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, frontend/AGENTS.md and docs/quality/frontend/design-system.md. Entry points: The issue store from PT-8, frontend style guide tokens (--studio-*).

## Deliver
Define `deck.json` (slides with layout title, ranked list, decision list, trend, numbers, operations watch; blocks referencing item ids and stats fields). The presenter builds a 7-slide weekly deck after each issue and a 10 to 12-slide monthly review deck, selecting items of 40 or more, at most three per slide, Critical first, an aspect slide only with an item of 70 or more, always a decisions slide, trends only with four weeks of data. One model call for slide titles and speaker notes. A validator refuses numbers without a source field and claims without an item id. Render 16:9 in the Studio with style guide tokens in both themes; export self-contained HTML (one slide per screen, arrow keys) and PDF. Add the stakeholder variant without bodies, costs and host names.

## Out of scope
PPTX export.

## Acceptance
- Every number on every slide resolves to a stats field or item
- Light and dark renders pass a contrast check
- Stakeholder variant contains no host names or costs
- Playwright captures of two slides in both themes saved

# Manager roles: chief of staff and budget steward

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573), decisions PT-D6, PT-D10. Read that Dossier and its workbench.json first, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/operator-agent-level/index.html (attention lease, OA-D3) and docs/security-model/index.html. Use the Dossier's recommended option for each named decision unless a recorded owner decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented.

Dependencies: PT-2, PT-4, PT-6. Resolve card ids (PT-n) to promoted task keys before starting dependent work.

Entry points: Manager operations from PT-2, POST /api/tasks/{id}/attention, card.requeue, promote-concept, the budget ledger.

## Deliver
Run manager occurrences on grounds built only from typed item fields (kind, factors, score, persona, fingerprint, links), never raw bodies or repository content. Chief of staff: order the proposal queue, adjust importance by at most ±15 with a reason (never below a floor), move persona-origin or watcher-proposal cards between Backlog and Ready with the attention lease and revision check (at most 5 per day, never into Progress or Human review), accept proposals into Preparation through promote-concept (at most 3 per day, never its own drafts), expire stale decision requests into the magazine. Budget steward: move allowance between personas by at most ±25 % per week, never raise the pool or its own or the chief of staff's allowance, pause a persona except the warden while a floor item of 90 or more is open. Escalate by decision request; no answer means no change. Every action is audited with actor and grant id, appears in the card timeline and the manager feed, and is undoable for 24 hours by the Owner.

## Out of scope
T2 operations, accepting out of Human review, decision cards: never.

## Acceptance
- Each bound has a test that refuses with a receipt
- An Owner-held attention lease refuses the manager write
- Undo restores lane and revision and counts against calibration
- No manager grounds pack contains an item body

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573, Persona capabilities addendum of 10 November 2026), decisions PT-D17. Read that Dossier's Persona capabilities section and its workbench.json first, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/security-model/index.html and docs/operations/security/overview.md (SM-1, SM-4, SM-5). Add grant kind `delegated-t2` for the delegable capabilities `check.skip`, `decision.override` and `settings.change` only. Owner only, fresh step-up, one capability, one project and one named target, expiry 24 hours by default and 72 at most, use cap 3 by default and 10 at most, not renewable, never in a template and not renewed by Renew team grants. Every use writes a control plane audit entry with grant id, session, target and instruction source, a `persona.t2-used` decision stream event and a persona item at 70 or more. Refuse a use when the occurrence was triggered by untrusted content. Revoke without step-up; stop-all and the SM-2 kill switch revoke it.

Every other T2 operation, which stays per-request approval or closed.

Source: docs/persona-team/index.html (AGT-3573, Persona capabilities addendum of 10 November 2026), decisions PT-D18. Read that Dossier's Persona capabilities section and its workbench.json first, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/security-model/index.html and docs/operations/security/overview.md (SM-1, SM-4, SM-5). Entry points: the PT-3 scheduler in the Watcher sweep, backend/Features/Operator/Decisions/, the new card.comment route, the operator log, orchestrator chat sessions.

## Deliver
Make event and mention subscriptions grant entries: `trigger.event:<type>` only for event types whose source interface the persona holds, and `trigger.mention:<surface>` for `@handle` in card comments, the operator log, Dossier comments and the Owner's chat. A mention wakes the persona, enters the grounds as untrusted content with its instruction source, and grants nothing. Rate limit mentions per persona (6 per hour by default) and coalesce further mentions into the next occurrence; a persona mentioning another counts against its own rate.

Usage records (PT-18).

- An event type the persona cannot read never wakes it
- A seventh mention within an hour joins the next occurrence instead of starting one
- A mention never changes the persona's grants or admits an action
